attribute_fields.COMMENTS: US Virgin Islands territory income tax calculation. USVI uses mirror code system - same rates as federal tax. Bona fide residents file with VI Bureau of Internal Revenue instead of IRS. EDC benefits provide up to 90% tax reduction. Non-residents use Form 8689 for income allocation per IRC 932.

initial_action.action_postfix: "US VIRGIN ISLANDS TERRITORY TAX - Mirror Code System" job.audit_trail swap addto " Uses federal tax rates and rules (IRC mirror)" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.vi_income_tax xdef 0.0 /result.vi_income_tax_after_edc xdef

condition_details.condition_description: Meets bona fide residence test (183+ days, tax home, closer connection)
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.vi_days_present 183 >= result.vi_has_tax_home and result.vi_closer_connection and dup /result.vi_bona_fide_resident xdef

condition_details.condition_description: Has Economic Development Commission benefits (up to 90% reduction)

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VI tax for bona fide resident using mirror code
action_details.action_postfix:
true /result.vi_files_with_irb xdef false /result.vi_files_with_irs xdef
result.federal_income_tax /result.vi_income_tax xdef
result.vi_has_edc_benefits if result.vi_edc_qualified_income 0 > if result.vi_income_tax result.vi_edc_reduction_rate f* local@ edc_reduction > result.vi_income_tax edc_reduction f- /result.vi_income_tax_after_edc xdef " EDC benefits applied: " result.vi_edc_reduction_rate 100 f* cvs strconcat "% reduction" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Tax before EDC: $" result.vi_income_tax cvs strconcat " - After EDC: $" strconcat result.vi_income_tax_after_edc cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.vi_income_tax /result.vi_income_tax_after_edc xdef then else result.vi_income_tax /result.vi_income_tax_after_edc xdef then
" Bona fide VI resident - files with VI Bureau of Internal Revenue" job.audit_trail swap addto " Mirror code: uses federal tax rates (" result.filing_status strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " VI tax liability: $" result.vi_income_tax_after_edc cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

false /result.vi_bona_fide_resident xdef true /result.vi_requires_form_8689 xdef true /result.vi_files_with_irs xdef
result.vi_source_income 0 > if result.federal_income_tax result.vi_source_income f* result.agi f/ /result.vi_income_tax xdef result.vi_income_tax /result.vi_income_tax_after_edc xdef " Non-resident with VI source income - Form 8689 required" job.audit_trail swap addto " VI tax allocated based on VI-source income: $" result.vi_source_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " VI tax liability: $" result.vi_income_tax_after_edc cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else 0.0 /result.vi_income_tax xdef 0.0 /result.vi_income_tax_after_edc xdef " Non-resident with no VI source income - no VI tax" job.audit_trail swap addto then

policy_statement.policy_description: Calculate VI territory tax for bona fide residents using mirror code
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Bona fide USVI residents file with VI Bureau of Internal Revenue instead of IRS per IRC 932. USVI uses mirror code system with same rates as federal tax. EDC benefits provide up to 90% tax reduction on qualified income."

"Non-bona fide residents with VI-source income must file Form 8689 to allocate income between USVI and US. Tax allocated proportionally based on VI-source income. Must meet 183-day presence test for bona fide resident status."
